name: Captcha questions dblog
description: Logs failed captcha entries to separate database table
project_description: Optional submodule of Captcha questions. When enabled and switched on in the parent settings, it records every failed captcha submission (timestamp, IP, form_id, question asked, answer given, and the correct answer) into a dedicated database table, captcha_questions_dblog, created by hook_schema. A paged, sortable admin report at /admin/config/people/captcha_questions/failed_submissions lists these entries. Depends on the captcha_questions parent module.
